environment.description: Kubernetes pod with annotation 'seccomp.security.alpha.kubernetes.io/pod: localhost/notification-hardened.json' referencing a custom seccomp profile stored at /var/lib/kubelet/seccomp/notification-hardened.json. The profile uses SCMP_ACT_ERRNO for syscalls: connect(2), sendto(2), sendmsg(2) when the file descriptor target is NOT in the pre-approved set (only the Kafka broker IPs on port 9092 are allowed via BPF argument filtering on sockaddr_in). The socket(2) syscall is restricted to AF_UNIX only via SCMP_CMP_MASKED_EQ on the first argument. Additionally, the pod runs with a NetworkPolicy that only permits egress to kafka-headless.kafka.svc.cluster.local:9092 and denies all other egress including to the SMTP relay. DNS is resolved via a sidecar coredns cache with static entries.

config.seccomp_socket_filter: SCMP_ACT_ERRNO on socket() unless domain=AF_UNIX; SCMP_ACT_ERRNO on connect/sendto/sendmsg to non-approved sockaddr
config.dns_resolution: sidecar coredns with static entries only
